text:
Columbus closes a three-game road trip in Dallas, 1-1-0 so far, and arrives off a 3-2 loss at CAR two days ago. The Blue Jackets are 2-3-0 in their last five and have been outscored 15-11. The Stars end a six-game home stand having lost to NJD and MTL (5-2 on Wednesday) after a 3-0 start to it, and they're playing without Kyle Capobianco, Esa Lindell and Radek Faksa.

Dallas has controlled more of the play. At five on five the Stars have taken 53% of the expected goals (the quality of chances) in their games, to 47% for Columbus. Our model has it 3.07 to 2.64 for the Stars tonight. Dallas also takes 4.2 penalties a game, which keeps handing opponents power plays. In goal, projected starter Jake Oettinger is 8.2 goals saved above expected this season (how many more goals he's stopped than an average goalie would on the same shots). Projected Columbus starter Jet Greaves is at -1.2, though he was +15.0 last season.

For Columbus, we'd watch Kent Johnson, who has 10 points in his last ten and, per our numbers, is getting better chances too. As The Hockey News put it, his "3 Point Night Helps Blue Jackets Overcome 3-0 Blown Lead." He has a 46% chance at a point tonight. For Dallas, Wyatt Johnston has the best goal chance in the game at 40%, and Mikko Rantanen sits two points shy of 800 for his career.
